data_description.zone_urls: Enter the URLs of the GeoJSON files that contain the zones you want to track. This supports both websites and files in the /config directory.
data_description.prioritize_zone_files: When a device is inside zones from more than one file, zones from the file higher in your list win by default. A zone can override this by setting its own priority value.
data_description.download_zones: Use a local GeoJSON file to store the zones in. This will load the above defined files into a single file. The entities will only use this single file to retrieve the zones from. If no GeoJSON files are defined we will create an empty GeoJSON file.
data_description.registered_entities: Select the entities that you want to track in the zones.
data_description.expose_coordinates: When enabled, the mirror entity writes latitude, longitude, and gps_accuracy to its attributes on every update — Home Assistant's recorder then persists a full location history. Disable to publish only the zone name (privacy-first). New installs default to off.
data_description.allow_private_urls: Turn this on only if your zone source is on your local network — e.g. the companion editor add-on at http://192.168.x.x:8000/zones.json. Public https:// URLs and files in /config work without it. Loopback, link-local, and cloud-metadata addresses stay blocked either way.
data_description.consent: This integration continuously records the GPS location of the device_tracker entities you select. Tick to confirm before continuing.

legacy_expose_coordinates.title: Polygonal Zones is recording GPS coordinates
legacy_expose_coordinates.description: The Polygonal Zones entry "{title}" was created before the privacy option existed, so it exposes latitude/longitude/accuracy as entity attributes and Home Assistant records a full location history. To stop this, open the integration's options and turn off "Expose GPS coordinates".
